Cosmic Explorer: Universe & Astrophysics Literacy skill – initial release

- Enables structured explanations on cosmology, astronomy, and the universe’s architecture.
- Covers celestial nomenclature, classification, and essential physical phenomena (gravity, expansion, time dilation).
- Details tools and missions for space exploration, differentiating telescope types and space program examples.
- Provides clear definitions and corrections for common misconceptions (e.g., zero gravity, dark matter vs. dark energy).
- Includes discussion of the universe’s possible futures and suggests pathways for skill extension (astrobiology, exoplanet hunting, cosmic calendar).
